Use a regular coarse square pixel lattice, roughly 56–64 logical pixels of character height, enlarged uniformly. characters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a corrected IDLE TURNAROUND from this Magnus reference. Output EXACTLY FOUR full-body standing idle sprites, in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, four evenly spaced identical cells: front facing down, profile facing right, back facing up, profile facing left. NO WALKING POSES. Keep Magnus's FAT STOCKY body with broad ROUND BELLY, orange cream-floral Hawaiian shirt, dark trousers, brown shoes and brown facial BEARD. Critical correction: Magnus is COMPLETELY BALD. Entire scalp from forehead, temples, crown and sides to nape is BARE SKIN in ALL FOUR views. Absolutely NO HAIR on top or sides, no brown hair rim, no tufts, no ponytail. Eyebrows and facial beard stay, but scalp is fully bare. Do not confuse beard with scalp hair. Same recognizable face/body mass and mature proportions, detailed sharp square PIXEL ART matching reference, top-down/slightly angled RPG perspective. Genuine transparent background, plenty of empty padding between figures and around every head/foot, equal character height/ground baselines, no shadow, labels, borders, grids or text. The back view clearly shows a large uninterrupted bare bald scalp above the shirt collar.
